prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit. To make that practical, here’s a short checklist to evaluate agencies and a quick offer to shortlist options for you.

What matters most
- Track record & case studies showing measurable results (revenue, leads, conversion rate improvements).  
- Relevant industry experience and channel expertise (SEO, PPC, paid social, content, email, web development).  
- Clear KPIs, reporting cadence, and transparency about methods/tools.  
- Team structure and day-to-day contact (who will do the work).  
- Pricing model and minimum commitment/contract length.  
- Client references and recent reviews.  
- Cultural fit and communication style (local vs. remote, availability).  

Questions to ask any agency
- Have you worked with companies in my industry or with similar goals? Can I see case studies?  
- What specific KPIs will you target and how will you measure success?  
- Who will do our work and how many hours per week/month will they spend?  
- What tools do you use (analytics, bid management, CMS, creative)? Any extra costs?  
- What is your pricing model and typical contract length?  
- Can you provide 2–3 client references I can contact?  
- How do you handle reporting and project communication?

How to compare candidates
- Create a simple scorecard (experience, strategy, pricing, references, chemistry) and weight what’s most important to you.  
- Ask for a short pilot project or 60–90 day trial before committing long-term.

If you want, I can:
- Put together a shortlist of top St. Louis agencies tailored to your needs (give me your goals, services needed, industry, and monthly budget).  
- Draft an RFP or a set of interview questions for you to send to agencies.  

Which would you prefer — a personalized shortlist or an RFP/interview template? If shortlist, tell me: what are your main goals (lead gen, ecommerce sales, brand awareness, etc.), monthly budget, and industry.
